story_overview: Military officers Claire, Sabrina, and Evelyn are questioned by Conrad inside an interview trailer, revealing deep-seated tensions and distress. The investigation culminates in a formal tribunal hearing where Conrad, Claire, Evelyn, and Annelise must confront the truth of the matter.

video_prompts:
Claire: Woman with light brown hair pulled back neatly into a bun, wearing a dark green military dress uniform jacket over a white collared shirt and a black tie.
Conrad: Man in a formal military dress uniform, with the jacket adorned with various decorations including medals, ribbons, and insignia.
The Interview Trailer: Interior of an interview RV/trailer featuring a tan couch and windows covered by closed horizontal blinds.

Close-up on Claire sitting inside The Interview Trailer, engaged in a conversation. Her facial expression transitions from a brief smile to a pensive, serious look. Conrad sits opposite her, listening intently.
action_descriptions: Close-up on Claire sitting inside The Interview Trailer, engaged in a conversation. Her facial expression transitions from a brief smile to a pensive, serious look. Conrad sits opposite her, listening intently.

Inside The Interview Trailer, Evelyn and Conrad sit together. Close-up on Evelyn. Her face is filled with distress and sadness as she looks just off-screen. A single tear begins to roll down her cheek.

Annelise: Woman with blonde hair styled in a neat bun.
Base Administration HQ: Exterior of a large, institutional brick administration building with front steps, a facade sign reading 'JOINT FORCES TRAINING BASE ADMINISTRATION BUILDING', and displayed military flags and seals.
the ceremonial flags and seals: A collection of fabric military service flags and an American flag, each with a tall, polished wooden pole topped by a decorative golden eagle finial, and large, round, intricately detailed military seals of carved wood or cast bronze.

Wide, high-angle shot of Base Administration HQ. Sabrina, Annelise, wearing the green dress uniform, Conrad, and Evelyn walk together down the front steps of the administration building. The building's facade features the building facade sign mounted above a display of the ceremonial flags and seals near the entrance.

video_prompts:
The Tribunal Chamber: Formal indoor military hearing room with wood-paneled walls and long, wooden hearing desks equipped with yellow legal pads and a wooden gavel.
the long hearing table: Long, rectangular hearing room table made of dark, polished wood with a smooth surface.

From an over-the-shoulder shot behind a seated Claire, Conrad stands and speaks to the officers. Seated beside Claire at the long hearing table, Annelise and Evelyn listen intently, occasionally making notes on yellow legal pads.

the leather armchair: High-backed armchair with dark, polished wood arms and legs and black leather upholstery.
the legal pads and folders: Yellow paper legal pads with blue ruled lines and blue paper file folders.

Over-the-shoulder shot of Claire, wearing the green dress uniform, speaking while seated in the leather armchair at the long hearing table in The Tribunal Chamber. In the background, Evelyn sits at the long hearing table and listens intently, occasionally nodding in response, with the legal pads and folders placed on the table in front of her.
From an over-the-shoulder perspective of Annelise in the foreground, Evelyn stands and speaks with a slight smile inside The Tribunal Chamber. Annelise sits at the long hearing table, listening.

the black and gold pen: Slim, black lacquered ballpoint pen with a polished gold-colored metal clip, a matching gold-colored band around the center, and a retractable click-top.
Over-the-shoulder shot in The Tribunal Chamber. Claire, wearing the green dress uniform, and Evelyn sit side-by-side at the long hearing table, listening with serious expressions. Claire picks up the black and gold pen from the table.
